EncryptionUtils.caesar_cipher:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Encrypts plaintext by shifting each alphabetic character by shift positions, preserving case and leaving non-alphabetic characters unchanged." caesar_cipher]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> plaintext </REF>: string "The input text to encrypt."
        <REF> shift </REF>: integer "The number of alphabet positions to shift each alphabetic character; negative values shift backward."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> ciphertext </REF>: string "The encrypted output string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize ciphertext to an empty string. RESULT ciphertext]
            [COMMAND For each character char in plaintext, if char.isalpha() is true, execute the alphabetic branch based on char.isupper(); otherwise execute the non-alphabetic branch. RESULT char]
            [COMMAND Return ciphertext. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: For the current character in the plaintext loop, char.isalpha() is true and char.isupper() is true.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set ascii_offset to 65. RESULT ascii_offset]
            [COMMAND Compute shifted_char = chr((ord(char) - ascii_offset + shift) % 26 + ascii_offset). RESULT shifted_char]
            [COMMAND Append shifted_char to ciphertext. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: For the current character in the plaintext loop, char.isalpha() is true and char.isupper() is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set ascii_offset to 97. RESULT ascii_offset]
            [COMMAND Compute shifted_char = chr((ord(char) - ascii_offset + shift) % 26 + ascii_offset). RESULT shifted_char]
            [COMMAND Append shifted_char to ciphertext. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: For the current character in the plaintext loop, char.isalpha() is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append char unchanged to ciphertext. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EncryptionUtils.vigenere_cipher:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Encrypts plain_text using the Vigenère cipher key from self.key, preserving letter case and leaving non-alphabetic characters unchanged while advancing the key only for letters." vigenere_cipher]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> plain_text </REF>: string "The plaintext string to encrypt."
        <REF> self.key </REF>: string "The Vigenère cipher key used to compute per-letter shifts."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> encrypted_text </REF>: string "The resulting Vigenère-encrypted string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize encrypted_text to an empty string. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND Initialize key_index to 0. RESULT key_index]
            [COMMAND Iterate through each character char in plain_text from the first character to the last. RESULT char]
            [COMMAND Within the iteration over char, evaluate whether char.isalpha() is true. RESULT is_alpha]
            [COMMAND Within the iteration over char, when char.isalpha() is true, compute shift as ord(self.key[key_index % len(self.key)].lower()) - ord('a'). RESULT shift]
            [COMMAND Within the alphabetic branch, compute encrypted_char as chr((ord(char.lower()) - ord('a') + shift) % 26 + ord('a')). RESULT encrypted_char]
            [COMMAND Within the alphabetic branch, append encrypted_char.upper() to encrypted_text if char.isupper() is true; otherwise append encrypted_char as is. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND Within the alphabetic branch, increment key_index by 1. RESULT key_index]
            [COMMAND After the iteration over all characters in plain_text has completed, return encrypted_text. RESULT encrypted_text]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within the iteration over char in plain_text, char.isalpha() is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the iteration over char, append char unchanged to encrypted_text and do not increment key_index. RESULT encrypted_text]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EncryptionUtils.rail_fence_cipher:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Encrypts plain_text using a rail-fence cipher by writing characters into a zigzag pattern across the given number of rails and reading the non-placeholder cells row by row to produce the ciphertext." rail_fence_cipher]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> plain_text </REF>: string "The plaintext string to encrypt."
        <REF> rails </REF>: integer "The number of rails, or rows, used in the rail-fence zigzag pattern."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> encrypted_text </REF>: string "The resulting ciphertext string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a 2D list fence with rails rows and len(plain_text) columns, filling every cell with the newline character, and assign it to fence. RESULT fence]
            [COMMAND Set direction to -1, row to 0, and col to 0. RESULT direction, row, col]
            [COMMAND For each character char in plain_text, if row is 0 or rails - 1, reverse direction; then place char at fence[row][col], increment col by 1, and increase row by direction. RESULT fence]
            [COMMAND Initialize encrypted_text to an empty string. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 through rails - 1 and each column j from 0 through len(plain_text) - 1, if fence[i][j] is not the newline character, append fence[i][j] to encrypted_text. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND Return encrypted_text. RESULT encrypted_text]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
